name: Egg
description: The ultimate culinary savior for your empty wallet before payday. Versatile, cheap, and fragile.

name: Sugar
description: Sweet, crystalline dopamine. Stickier than your ex and guaranteed to give you an instant cavity.

name: Flour
description: Powdered chaos. It gets on your face, your clothes, and makes everything thicker—including your waistline.

name: Rice
description: Fluffy white grains. The literal blank canvas of the food world. Respect the grains or face Asian wrath!

name: Spaghetti
description: Naked Italian noodles. Currently locked in a straight line, just waiting for hot water to make them wild.

name: Olive Oil
description: Liquid Mediterranean sunshine. Drink a shot of this if you want your digestive tract to become a slip-and-slide.

name: Chili Sauce
description: Pure, unadulterated fire. Keep a fire extinguisher and a cold gallon of milk within arm's reach.

name: Pepper
description: Tiny black dust that makes your steak taste premium and your nose violently explode in sneezes.

name: Canned Beans
description: The musical fruit! Eat a can of these to instantly transform into a campfire-loving cowboy.

name: Honey
description: Sticky bee spit that never expires. Technically stolen life savings, but it tastes way too good to care.

name: Clock
description: Ticking metallic stress. Tells you exactly how much time you’ve wasted trying to cook instead of doing quests.

name: Knife
description: Sharp, shiny, and pointy. Excellent for dicing onions, terrible for scratching your back. Handle with care!

name: Rolling Pin
description: A heavy wooden cylinder. Used for flattening dough, crushing spices, or threatening bad customers.

name: Whisk
description: A metal cage on a stick. It spins things around real fast until your arm goes completely numb.

name: Sponge
description: A squishy plastic brick. Smells like old water and exists purely to erase your kitchen failures.

name: Dish Soap
description: Neon-colored chemical goo. Turns grease into bubbles and makes everything taste like a hospital visit.

name: Apples
description: Crisp, juicy, and sweet. Keeps the doctor away, assuming your aim is good enough to hit them.

name: Bananas
description: Conveniently pre-wrapped yellow mush. High in potassium, great for slips, and loved by monkeys and gym bros.

name: Pineapples
description: A fruit wearing a spiky crown. Tastes amazing, but contains enzymes that actively try to eat you back.

name: Lemons
description: Nature's yellow sour bomb. When life gives you these, squeeze them into your enemies' eyes.

name: Oranges
description: Opaque balls of liquid sunshine. Peeling them is a test of patience, but the sugar rush is worth it.

name: Potatoes
description: Dirt-covered lumps of pure potential. Can become fries, chips, vodka, or your teammate’s brain.

name: Carrots
description: Crunchy orange sticks that supposedly help you see in the dark. Bugs Bunny's favorite weapon.

name: Onions
description: An edible flashbang. It has layers, it has flavor, and it will absolutely make you cry like a baby.

name: Garlic
description: Deliciously aromatic cloves. Keeps your food tasting gourmet and ensures vampires stay 50 feet away.

name: Bell Peppers
description: Colorful, hollow veggies. They look spicy but are actually sweet and empty inside—just like my hopes.

name: Eggplants
description: A glossy purple vegetable. Mostly used as a suggestive emoji, but behaves surprisingly well on a grill.

name: Mushroom
description: Fungi harvested from the damp dark. 50% chance it makes a great soup, 50% chance you see God.

name: Bacon
description: Crispy strips of cured pork fat. The loudest crunch and the best smell in the entire galaxy.

name: Pork Ribs
description: Thick meat on sturdy bones. Guaranteed to cover your entire face and fingers in sticky BBQ sauce.

name: Beef Steak
description: A premium cut of red meat. Treat it with respect, sear it hot, and never, ever make it well-done.

name: Chicken Breast
description: Lean, bland, and unseasoned. Gym bros love it, flavor hates it, but your muscles need it.

name: Milk
description: Liquid calcium straight from the cow. Warm it up to cure insomnia, or pour it over cereal to spawn happiness.

name: Butter
description: Pure solid dairy fat. The secret ingredient that makes restaurant food taste better than your home cooking.

name: Cheese
description: Coagulated milk gold. Melts beautifully, stretches infinitely, and makes literally any dish 10 times better.

name: Soda
description: Liquid carbonated static. Packed with enough sugar to make your teeth vibrate and your energy levels skyrocket.

name: Blue Cheese
description: Coagulated milk gold... with an intentional moldy twist. Looks highly questionable and smells intensely pungent, but tastes like absolute luxury to the brave.

name: Ricotta Cheese
description: A fluffy, snowy white whey cheese cloud. Incredibly soft, creamy, and mild enough to be smuggled into both savory pastas and sweet desserts.

name: Yogurt
description: Tangy, creamy milk goo packed with good bacteria. It wants so badly to be ice cream, but its healthy conscience forces it to remain a breakfast snack.

name: Apple Cider Vinegar
description: A sharp, tongue-twisting sour tonic. One sniff will violently clear your sinuses; one drop will punch a lazy dish right in the face with flavor.

name: Shrimp
description: A tiny, translucent sea bug with long twitchy feelers. Plump, sweet, and highly addictive once you peel off its armor

name: Tuna
description: A massive, torpedo-shaped ocean titan. It is a solid muscle machine of the deep sea, ready to yield an absolute mountain of rich red meat.

name: Salmon
description: A majestic, silver-scaled fish fresh from leaping up wild rivers. Beneath its sleek scales lies that signature bright pink, oil-rich flesh.

name: Crab
description: A grumpy coastal warrior waving two massive pinching claws. It walks sideways, glares at you, and relies on its rock-hard armor to protect its sweet meat.

name: Piranha
description: A ferocious river monster with a severe underbite and razor-sharp teeth. Cooking it whole is a satisfying act of revenge for your bitten fingers.

name: Oyster
description: A rough, rocky, rugged shell that looks like a piece of ocean debris. Pry it open to find a plump, glistening creature swimming in pure sea essence.

name: Scallop
description: A fan-shelled mollusk that zips through the water by clapping its shells together. Inside rests a single, prized, buttery-soft cylinder of pure luxury.

name: Lobster
description: The undisputed armored monarch of the seabed. Features crushing claws, long majestic antennae, and a dense, heavy tail built for high-society dining.

name: Pigeon
description: A small, plump, feathery bird. It has a rich, gamey flavor and a distinctly chaotic habit of bobbing its head constantly while staring at you.

name: Crow
description: A sleek, jet-black bird of ill omen. Its meat is notoriously tough, stringy, and leaves a lingering aftertaste of bad luck and existential regret.

name: Rat
description: A twitchy, long-tailed survivor of the shadows. Cooking this whole rodent is a loud cry for help, but hey, survival means protein is protein.

name: Bat
description: A leathery, winged mammal of the night. Cooking this whole creature creates a highly chaotic vibe in the kitchen. The soup is definitely staring back at you.

name: Duck
description: A stout waterfowl with webbed feet and water-proof feathers. It carries a thick, glorious layer of natural fat right under its skin for maximum crispiness.

name: Bees
description: A small, buzzing swarm of fuzzy yellow-and-black insects. Eating them whole gives a crunchy, sweet burst followed by a sharp, stinging sense of guilt.

name: Old Shoes
description: A tattered, mud-stained leather boot. Boiling this rubber-soled relic does absolutely nothing to soften the leather, but it guarantees a broth that smells like gym socks.

name: Starfish
description: A rigid, bumpy five-pointed star harvested from the seafloor. Breaking off a stiff arm to eat the mushy green insides is a true test of human courage.

name: Octopus
description: A dramatic, squishy bag of pure intelligence with eight suction-cupped tentacles. It looks like a miniature alien, but turns incredibly tender over an open flame.

name: Frog
description: A bug-eyed, green amphibian built for jumping. Its slender legs look like tiny chicken wings but carry a much higher spring capacity before hitting the pan.
